name: Prop Continuity Audit
description: Track objects, letters, keys, weapons, and tokens: possession, damage, and last seen state. Continuity audits are declarative templates. They do not modify novel data or bypass Canon, Revision, or permission systems. Workflow execution is not implemented.

stages.title: Collect Context
stages.intent: Gather established facts for this audit domain. Read-only.

stages.title: Identify Constraints
stages.intent: List rules, dates, identities, or object states later text must honor.

stages.title: Compare Current Content
stages.intent: Place the passage or chapter against those constraints.

stages.title: Detect Conflicts
stages.intent: Record mismatches without rewriting the novel.

stages.title: Classify Severity
stages.intent: Separate continuity breaks, ambiguities, and style-only notes.

stages.title: Recommend Resolution
stages.intent: Propose human-reviewable options. Do not apply a patch.

stages.title: Human Review
stages.intent: Require a person to accept, reject, or defer each finding.
